description: Get everything needed to build one acceptance criterion, in a few thousand tokens: the criterion, its story and feature, the pages and interactions it touches, the data entities, access rules, related code and conventions. Use this during a build instead of the whole-project blueprint. The pack carries a `spec_seq` (pass it to vibemap_submit_for_review) and an etag, so re-checking mid-build is cheap.

includeSource.description: Include the source of related code (default false)
